findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "onhand" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: discover_local, search_local_offerings, get_website, list_website_edits, get_visibility_report, get_connection_link, get_billing_link, confirm_website_edit, confirm_undo_website_edit, prepare_visibility_fixes, override_visibility_check, draft_social_post, get_content_calendar, list_verified_reviews, report_action_outcome, find_nearby_businesses · Private data: discover_local, search_local_offerings, list_connections, draft_social_post, confirm_booking, confirm_checkout_handoff, prepare_quote_request, confirm_quote_handoff, report_action_outcome, find_nearby_businesses, request_area, ask_business, forward_question, check_availability · Public sink: discover_local, search_local_offerings, confirm_website_edit, confirm_undo_website_edit, update_business_description, draft_social_post, draft_content_calendar, get_content_calendar, update_calendar_post, submit_verified_review, find_nearby_businesses, report_business_facts, request_area, forward_question, check_availability · Destructive: update_business_description, update_service, update_faq, run_visibility_check, remove_visibility_override, update_calendar_post.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
